reason: Both cover the same facets (sex-steroid synthesis, adrenal corticosteroid/CYP deficiency disorders, vitamin D/retinoid CYPs, thyroid and growth-hormone endocrine context), but A does so with a cleaner nested ladder while B adds many near-duplicate 10-24-member steroidogenesis themes and an odd glaucoma/CYP26 mix.

B keeps the key facets of nascent-chain folding (CCT/TRiC and prefoldin, tubulin/actin folding, ER targeting and quality control, heat-shock/HSF1, aggrephagy/proteostasis, UPR, secretory traffic) with far fewer redundant CCT/TRiC variants, whereas A repeats the chaperonin core many times and adds peripheral cilia/sperm and mitochondrial-cristae themes.

B is a focused set on liver regeneration and hepatocyte proliferation (HGF/MET and RTK signalling, survival, thyroid-hormone control), while A adds that core plus mostly unrelated germline/trophoblast/zygotic and branching-organ themes; its only useful extra is the pancreatic endoderm lineage theme.

Both present the same contexts (WNT/beta-catenin destruction-complex ladder with cancer mutants, Hippo crosstalk, Notch and Hedgehog developmental signalling), but A gives a clean nested progression while B splits the WNT core into many near-identical 10-31-member variants.

A gives a concise ladder from purine nucleoside catabolism (ADA/PNP) through deoxy-purine, salvage, NUDT/thiopurine and full purine metabolism up to all nucleotide metabolism, while B covers the same biology with roughly twice as many overlapping intermediate themes.

B covers the essential contexts (snRNA-type Pol II/Pol III promoter transcription, snRNP and spliceosome function, histone/snRNA 3'-end processing, mRNA export and nuclear decay, Pol I/ribosome biogenesis) with less redundancy, whereas A adds many overlapping splicing/Pol III variants and drifts into broad miRNA/mRNA-decay and translation-initiation themes.
